modern: Look within. Let neither the particular quality of anything nor its value escape you.
original: Look within. Let neither the peculiar quality of anything nor its value escape thee.
notification: Look within. Let neither the particular quality of anything nor its value escape you.
notification_original: Look within. Let neither the peculiar quality of anything nor its value escape thee.

explained.summary: Look beneath the surface. With anything you meet, notice what it actually is and what it’s really worth, instead of taking its appearance or its reputation on trust. Marcus is reminding himself not to let either of those slip past unexamined.
